entries.text: A gloved hand lifts {name}, {f:details}, from its velvet cradle by lantern light
A thief on a rope lowers toward {name}, moonlight pooling on its {f:material}
Tight on {name} tucked inside a fence's coat, the {f:objectType} catching the last of the alley light
Mid-chase, {name} spins from a thief's grip, its {f:material} flashing under a full moon
Pirates haul {name} over the rail in a torn net, stormlight flashing on its {f:material}
Drow fingers pry {name} from a sleeping dwarf, faerzress glowing on its {f:material}
{name} lies alone on a stone table, {f:details}, as frost spreads out from it in rings
Close on the hand that holds {name}, blackening from the fingertips as the {f:objectType} pulses
Candles gutter around {name}; in the dark, only its {f:material} still glows
Every mirror in the shop shows {name}, {f:details}, but not the hand that holds it
A hanged man's fingers clutch {name}, crows circling, dusk light on its {f:material}
Spectral hands rise from the grave-dirt around {name}, its {f:material} rimed with frost
{name} lies between two signatures on a contract, one wet with ink, one still smoking
A clawed hand and a human one both grip {name}, {f:details}, over a guttering candle
Close on the scales: {name} on one pan, a single heart-red gem on the other, perfectly level
At a lantern-lit crossroads, a hooded stranger holds out {name}, {f:details}
In a ring of hellfire, a devil's talon taps {name}, its {f:material} glowing cherry-red
A faerie queen's pale hand trades a single rose for {name} under a sky of falling blossom
{name} lies on a friend's pillow, {f:details}, beside a note in a familiar hand
A former ally turns {name} on its old owner, torchlight running along its {f:material}
Two silhouettes embrace on a bridge at dusk; one slips {name} from the other's belt
The {f:objectType} lies in a pool of spilled wine beside an overturned chair, a knife quivering in the table
An apprentice's shadow falls across the master's desk as {name} vanishes into a sleeve
{name} rests on the silt of a drowned hall, green light touching its {f:material}
Snow drifts half over {name}, {f:details}, beside a frozen hand
Roots grip {name} at the bottom of a pit, and a torch lowered on a rope finds it at last
Behind cracked, sunken glass: the {f:objectType}, its {f:material} dulled by centuries
{name} tumbles slowly through the Astral Sea, {f:details}, lit by a dead god's glow
Deep in blue glacier ice, {name} hangs frozen mid-fall, torchlight bleeding through from above
{name} rises off its pedestal on its own, {f:details}, dust streaming away in a slow ring
Sleeping fingers twitch as {name} stirs, its {f:material} kindling from within
In a dark museum hall, the {f:objectType} turns on its stand to face the night watchman's lantern
Sparks leap from {name} across an alchemist's bench as it {f:function}
Forge coals flare white as {name} wakes on the anvil, {f:details}
A beam of dawn light strikes {name} on the altar, and it lifts, humming, above the praying monks
{name} hangs above a sealed door, {f:details}, as a thief's torch rounds the corner
Close on a skeletal hand still wrapped around {name}, laid across the tomb's threshold
A burglar recoils as {name} flares, its {f:material} throwing white light up the walls
At the centre of a ring of standing stones, {name} sits on a moss-grown stump in the first dawn light
{name} lies across the knees of a stone king in a sunlit crypt, dust motes turning above it
A stained-glass window throws the image of {name} across the chapel floor, exactly where it now lies
A child lifts {name} from a market stall, and every bird in the square takes flight at once
Close on an old tapestry of a hero holding the {f:objectType}, the real one glinting on the floor below
{name} blazes up in a seer's scrying bowl, {f:details}, as the water begins to boil
Shamans ring {name} with antlers and ochre as a red comet crosses the sky
